requirements.reason: Application database URL, environment, pool-size, maximum-overflow, timeout, and safe-error parsing must remain explicit and safe.
The SQLAlchemy application engine must apply the configured per-process pool size, maximum overflow, and pool-wait timeout without claiming deployment-wide provider capacity.
Request database sessions must remain per use, close after success, roll back ordinary exceptions, and let cancellation propagate after cleanup.
Application import, health, shutdown, and checkout timeout behavior must remain predictable and must not expose database internals.
Alembic must resolve migration database access separately from normal application runtime while keeping local/test/CI fallback behavior explicit.
Complete SQLAlchemy metadata must load from a side-effect-free path without constructing or reusing the application engine.
Database URL, pool, timeout, and migration configuration must remain backend-only and must not introduce literal credentials or public exposure.
